# Importar datos

```{r}
importarDatos <- function(year) {
  archivo <- sprintf("data/BD %s.xlsx", year)
  hojas_nombres <- excel_sheets(archivo)
  
  df <- map_dfr(hojas_nombres, function(hoja) {
    read_excel(archivo, sheet = hoja) %>%
      mutate(estacion = hoja)
  }) %>%
    relocate(estacion)
  
  if ("Fecha y hora" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df <- df %>% rename(date = `Fecha y hora`)
  }
  
  if ("date" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df <- df %>% mutate(date = as.POSIXct(date))
  }
  
  return(df)
}

df2020 <- importarDatos("2020")
cat("2020 Importado\n")

df2021 <- importarDatos("2021")
cat("2021 Importado\n")

df2022 <- importarDatos("2022")
cat("2022 Importado\n")

df2023 <- importarDatos("2023")
cat("2023 Importado\n")

cat("2024 Importado\n")

df2025 <- importarDatos("2025")
```

## Limites Sensor

```{r}
limites <- read.csv("data/limites.csv") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -year,
    names_to = c("variable", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(min|max)"
  )

for (i in seq_len(nrow(limites))) {
  col <- limites$variable[i]
  yr  <- limites$year[i]
  mn  <- limites$min[i]
  mx  <- limites$max[i]
  
  if (col %in% colnames(df)) {
    df[[col]] <- if_else(df$year == yr & (df[[col]] < mn | df[[col]] > mx), NA_real_, df[[col]])
  }
}

```

## Clasificaciones Categorias Aire

```{r}
niveles <- c("Buena", "Aceptable", "Mala", "Muy Mala", "Extremadamente Mala")

# Por Estacion
df <- df %>%
  arrange(estacion, date) %>%
  group_by(estacion) %>%
  mutate(
    m_pm10 = rollmean(PM10, 12, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    m_pm25 = rollmean(`PM2.5`, 12, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    m_co   = rollmean(CO, 8, fill = NA, align = "right")
  )

#  Clasificación por fila
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    c_O3    = ordered(cut(O3,     c(-Inf, 0.058, 0.090, 0.135, 0.175, Inf), labels = niveles), levels = niveles),
    c_PM10  = ordered(cut(m_pm10, c(-Inf, 45,    50,    132,   213,   Inf), labels = niveles), levels = niveles),
    c_PM2.5 = ordered(cut(m_pm25, c(-Inf, 15,    25,    79,    130,   Inf), labels = niveles), levels = niveles),
    c_NO    = ordered(cut(NO2,    c(-Inf, 0.053, 0.106, 0.160, 0.213, Inf), labels = niveles), levels = niveles),
    c_SO2   = ordered(cut(SO2,    c(-Inf, 0.035, 0.075, 0.185, 0.304, Inf), labels = niveles), levels = niveles),
    c_CO    = ordered(cut(m_co,   c(-Inf, 5.00,  9.00,  12.00, 16.00, Inf), labels = niveles), levels = niveles)
  )

# Asignar el peor valor al día completo y limpiar
df <- df %>%
  group_by(estacion, dia = as.Date(date)) %>%
  mutate(
    calidad_O3    = as.character(max(c_O3, na.rm = TRUE)),
    calidad_PM10  = as.character(max(c_PM10, na.rm = TRUE)),
    calidad_PM2.5 = as.character(max(c_PM2.5, na.rm = TRUE)),
    calidad_NO    = as.character(max(c_NO, na.rm = TRUE)),
    calidad_SO2   = as.character(max(c_SO2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    calidad_CO    = as.character(max(c_CO, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("calidad_"), ~ if_else(.x == "-Inf", NA_character_, .x))) %>%
  dplyr::select(-dia, -m_pm10, -m_pm25, -m_co, -starts_with("c_"))

```

```{r}
fecha_inicio <- as.Date("2025-01-01")

# Horas activas
vector_horas <- c(
  "00:00:00" = FALSE, "01:00:00" = FALSE, "02:00:00" = FALSE, "03:00:00" = FALSE,
  "04:00:00" = FALSE, "05:00:00" = FALSE, "06:00:00" = FALSE, "07:00:00" = TRUE,
  "08:00:00" = TRUE,  "09:00:00" = TRUE,  "10:00:00" = TRUE,  "11:00:00" = TRUE,
  "12:00:00" = TRUE,  "13:00:00" = TRUE,  "14:00:00" = TRUE,  "15:00:00" = TRUE,
  "16:00:00" = TRUE,  "17:00:00" = TRUE,  "18:00:00" = TRUE,  "19:00:00" = TRUE,
  "20:00:00" = TRUE,  "21:00:00" = TRUE,  "22:00:00" = TRUE,  "23:00:00" = TRUE

# Predictores del modelo
predictores_modelo <- c(
  "hora", "O3", "O3_pico_lag1", "O3_pico_lag2", "O3_pico_lag3",
  "O3_pico_diff_1_2", "O3_pico_diff_2_1",
  "TOUT_max_lag1", "WSR_auc_lag1", "NO2_auc_lag1"
)

# Ponderaciones horarias por categoría
pesos_horas_hist <- tibble(
  hora = 0:23,
  Buena               = c(2.5, 2.5, 2.5, 2.5, 2.5, 2.5, 2.8, 3.0, 3.2, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5, 5.2, 5.8, 6.2, 6.5, 6.2, 5.5, 4.5, 3.8, 3.2, 2.8, 2.5, 2.5),
  Aceptable           = c(2.5, 2.5, 2.5, 2.5, 2.5, 2.5, 2.8, 3.0, 3.2, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5, 5.2, 5.8, 6.2, 6.5, 6.2, 5.5, 4.5, 3.8, 3.2, 2.8, 2.5, 2.5),
  Mala                = c(2.5, 2.5, 2.5, 2.5, 2.5, 2.5, 2.8, 3.0, 3.2, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5, 5.2, 5.8, 6.2, 6.5, 6.2, 5.5, 4.5, 3.8, 3.2, 2.8, 2.5, 2.5),
  `Muy Mala`          = c(2.3, 2.3, 2.3, 2.3, 2.3, 2.3, 2.6, 2.8, 3.0, 3.3, 3.8, 4.3, 5.0, 5.5, 5.9, 6.2, 5.9, 5.2, 4.3, 3.6, 3.0, 2.6, 2.3, 2.3),
  `Extremadamente Mala` = c(2.1, 2.1, 2.1, 2.1, 2.1, 2.1, 2.4, 2.6, 2.8, 3.1, 3.6, 4.1, 4.8, 5.2, 5.6, 5.9, 5.6, 4.9, 4.1, 3.4, 2.8, 2.4, 2.1, 2.1)
)

# Función de decisión categorica diaria
resolver_categoria_dia <- function(matriz_probs, niveles_calidad, horas_obs) {
  if (nrow(matriz_probs) == 0) return("Sin info suficiente")
  
  sub_pesos <- pesos_horas_hist %>%
    filter(hora %in% horas_obs) %>%
    arrange(match(hora, horas_obs))
  
  W <- sub_pesos %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(niveles_calidad)) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  col_sums <- colSums(W)
  col_sums[col_sums == 0] <- 1
  W_norm <- sweep(W, 2, col_sums, FUN = "/")
  
  p_ponderadas <- colSums(matriz_probs * W_norm, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat_ganadora <- names(which.max(p_ponderadas))
  prob_max     <- max(p_ponderadas)
  
  if (prob_max > 0.30) {
    return(cat_ganadora)
  } else {
    return("Sin info suficiente")
  }
}

```






# Balanceo y Entrenamiento

```{r}
df_diario <- df %>%
  filter(estacion == "CE") %>%
  mutate(dia_base = as.Date(date)) %>%
  group_by(dia_base) %>%
  summarise(
    O3_pico  = suppressWarnings(max(O3, na.rm = TRUE)),
    TOUT_max = suppressWarnings(max(TOUT, na.rm = TRUE)),
    WSR_auc  = sum(WSR, na.rm = TRUE),
    NO2_auc  = sum(NO2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    O3_pico  = if_else(is.infinite(O3_pico), NA_real_, O3_pico),
    TOUT_max = if_else(is.infinite(TOUT_max), NA_real_, TOUT_max)
  ) %>%
  arrange(dia_base) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ zoo::na.locf(.x, na.rm = FALSE))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ zoo::na.locf(.x, fromLast = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ if_else(is.na(.x), mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .x))) %>%
  mutate(
    O3_pico_lag1     = dplyr::lag(O3_pico, 1),
    O3_pico_lag2     = dplyr::lag(O3_pico, 2),
    O3_pico_lag3     = dplyr::lag(O3_pico, 3),
    O3_pico_diff_1_2 = O3_pico_lag1 - O3_pico_lag2,
    O3_pico_diff_2_1 = O3_pico_lag2 - O3_pico_lag1,
    TOUT_max_lag1    = dplyr::lag(TOUT_max, 1),
    WSR_auc_lag1     = dplyr::lag(WSR_auc, 1),
    NO2_auc_lag1     = dplyr::lag(NO2_auc, 1)
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ zoo::na.locf(.x, fromLast = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ if_else(is.na(.x), 0, .x))) %>%
  dplyr::select(-O3_pico, -TOUT_max, -WSR_auc, -NO2_auc)

vars_nuevas <- setdiff(names(df_diario), "dia_base")
df <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(vars_nuevas)) %>%
  mutate(dia_base = as.Date(date)) %>%
  left_join(df_diario, by = "dia_base") %>%
  dplyr::select(-dia_base)

calidad_diaria <- df %>%
  filter(estacion == "CE") %>%
  distinct(dia = as.Date(date), calidad_obj = calidad_O3) %>%
  filter(!is.na(calidad_obj))

dias_balanceados <- calidad_diaria %>%
  filter(format(dia, "%Y") <= "2024") %>%
  group_by(calidad_obj) %>%
  group_modify(~ dplyr::slice_head(.x, n = limite_muestras[.y$calidad_obj])) %>%
  ungroup()

# Guardar parámetros originales de O3 calculados exclusivamente en el periodo <= 2024
datos_train_stats <- df %>% filter(year <= 2024)
media_O3_orig     <- mean(datos_train_stats$O3, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_O3_orig        <- sd(datos_train_stats$O3, na.rm = TRUE)

# Estandarización de covariables usando únicamente medias y desviaciones de <= 2024
vars_a_escalar <- setdiff(predictores_modelo, "hora")
for (v in vars_a_escalar) {
  media_v <- mean(datos_train_stats[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_v    <- sd(datos_train_stats[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(sd_v) || sd_v == 0) sd_v <- 1
  df[[v]] <- as.numeric((df[[v]] - media_v) / sd_v)
}

formula_indep <- as.formula(paste("clase ~", paste(predictores_modelo, collapse = " + ")))

# Modelos a 1 y 2 días
datos_m1 <- df %>%
  filter(estacion == "CE", !is.na(O3)) %>%
  mutate(dia_obj = as.Date(date) + 1, hora = as.numeric(format(date, "%H"))) %>%
  inner_join(dias_balanceados, by = c("dia_obj" = "dia")) %>%
  mutate(clase = factor(calidad_obj, levels = niveles)) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(across(all_of(predictores_modelo))))

modelo_1dia <- multinom(formula_indep, data = datos_m1, trace = FALSE, MaxNWts = 3000)

datos_m2 <- df %>%
  filter(estacion == "CE", !is.na(O3)) %>%
  mutate(dia_obj = as.Date(date) + 2, hora = as.numeric(format(date, "%H"))) %>%
  inner_join(dias_balanceados, by = c("dia_obj" = "dia")) %>%
  mutate(clase = factor(calidad_obj, levels = niveles)) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(across(all_of(predictores_modelo))))

modelo_2dias <- multinom(formula_indep, data = datos_m2, trace = FALSE, MaxNWts = 3000)

```

# Predicciones 2025

```{r}
datos_ce_horas <- df %>%
  filter(estacion == "CE", !is.na(O3)) %>%
  mutate(dia = as.Date(date), hora = as.numeric(format(date, "%H"))) %>%
  filter(hora %in% horas_activas)

dias_eval_seleccionados <- calidad_diaria %>%
  filter(dia >= fecha_inicio & dia <= fecha_fin) %>%
  pull(dia)

predicciones <- map_dfr(dias_eval_seleccionados, function(target_day) {
  d1_raw <- datos_ce_horas %>% filter(dia == target_day - 1)
  d2_raw <- datos_ce_horas %>% filter(dia == target_day - 2)
  if (nrow(d1_raw) == 0 || nrow(d2_raw) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  horas_comunes <- intersect(d1_raw$hora, d2_raw$hora)
  if (length(horas_comunes) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  d1 <- d1_raw %>% filter(hora %in% horas_comunes) %>% arrange(hora)
  d2 <- d2_raw %>% filter(hora %in% horas_comunes) %>% arrange(hora)
  
  p1 <- predict(modelo_1dia, newdata = d1, type = "probs")
  p2 <- predict(modelo_2dias, newdata = d2, type = "probs")
  
  m1 <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(d1), ncol = length(niveles), dimnames = list(NULL, niveles))
  m2 <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(d2), ncol = length(niveles), dimnames = list(NULL, niveles))
  
  if (is.matrix(p1)) m1[, colnames(p1)] <- p1 else m1[, names(p1)] <- matrix(rep(p1, each = nrow(d1)), nrow = nrow(d1))
  if (is.matrix(p2)) m2[, colnames(p2)] <- p2 else m2[, names(p2)] <- matrix(rep(p2, each = nrow(d2)), nrow = nrow(d2))
  
  m_pond <- (0.7 * m1) + (0.3 * m2)
  
  tibble(
    dia           = target_day,
    pred_parcial  = resolver_categoria_dia(m1, niveles, horas_comunes),
    pred_completa = resolver_categoria_dia(m_pond, niveles, horas_comunes)
  )
}) %>%
  inner_join(calidad_diaria, by = "dia")

```

# Evaluación modelo

```{r}
calcular_metricas_matriz <- function(eval_df, col_pred) {
  R <- tibble(categoria = niveles) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      prediccion_totales             = sum(eval_df[[col_pred]] == categoria),
      `Verdadero Bueno`               = sum(eval_df[[col_pred]] == categoria & eval_df$calidad_obj == "Buena"),
      `Verdadero Aceptable`           = sum(eval_df[[col_pred]] == categoria & eval_df$calidad_obj == "Aceptable"),
      `Verdadero Malo`                = sum(eval_df[[col_pred]] == categoria & eval_df$calidad_obj == "Mala"),
      `Verdadero Muy Malo`            = sum(eval_df[[col_pred]] == categoria & eval_df$calidad_obj == "Muy Mala"),
      `Verdadero Extremadamente Malo` = sum(eval_df[[col_pred]] == categoria & eval_df$calidad_obj == "Extremadamente Mala"),
      aciertos_clase                  = sum(eval_df[[col_pred]] == categoria & eval_df$calidad_obj == categoria),
      `% de acierto`                  = ifelse(prediccion_totales > 0, round((aciertos_clase / prediccion_totales) * 100, 2), 0)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-aciertos_clase) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  mat_p <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(niveles), ncol = length(niveles), dimnames = list(niveles, niveles))
  for (i in 1:(length(niveles) - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):length(niveles)) {
      c1 <- niveles[i]
      c2 <- niveles[j]
      r1 <- R %>% filter(categoria == c1)
      r2 <- R %>% filter(categoria == c2)
      
      acierto1 <- sum(eval_df[[col_pred]] == c1 & eval_df$calidad_obj == c1)
      acierto2 <- sum(eval_df[[col_pred]] == c2 & eval_df$calidad_obj == c2)
      
      if (r1$prediccion_totales > 0 && r2$prediccion_totales > 0) {
        pval <- suppressWarnings(prop.test(x = c(acierto1, acierto2), n = c(r1$prediccion_totales, r2$prediccion_totales))$p.value)
        mat_p[c1, c2] <- round(pval, 4)
        mat_p[c2, c1] <- round(pval, 4)
      }
    }
  }
  
  attr(R, "sin_info") <- sum(eval_df[[col_pred]] == "Sin info suficiente")
  list(R = R, R_pvalue = as.data.frame(mat_p))
}

evaluar_efectividad <- function(eval_df, col_pred, nombre_modelo) {
  df_ef <- eval_df %>%
    filter(!.data[[col_pred]] %in% c("Sin info suficiente", "Muy Mala"),
           !calidad_obj %in% c("Muy Mala")) %>%
    mutate(
      grupo_real = if_else(calidad_obj %in% c("Buena", "Aceptable"), "Favorable", "Crítico"),
      grupo_pred = if_else(.data[[col_pred]] %in% c("Buena", "Aceptable"), "Favorable", "Crítico"),
      acierto_efectivo = (grupo_real == grupo_pred)
    )
  
  n_importan <- nrow(df_ef)
  n_aciertos <- sum(df_ef$acierto_efectivo)
  n_errores  <- sum(!df_ef$acierto_efectivo)
  pct        <- ifelse(n_importan > 0, round((n_aciertos / n_importan) * 100, 2), 0)
  
  tibble(
    Modelo                 = nombre_modelo,
    Casos_Relevantes       = n_importan,
    Aciertos_Efectivos     = n_aciertos,
    Errores_Graves         = n_errores,
    Pct_Acierto_Efectivo   = pct
  )
}

res_completo <- calcular_metricas_matriz(predicciones, "pred_completa")
res_parcial  <- calcular_metricas_matriz(predicciones, "pred_parcial")

R <- res_completo$R
R_pvalue <- res_completo$R_pvalue
R_parcial <- res_parcial$R
R_parcial_pvalue <- res_parcial$R_pvalue

R_efectivo <- bind_rows(
  evaluar_efectividad(predicciones, "pred_parcial", "Solo Ayer"),
  evaluar_efectividad(predicciones, "pred_completa", "Ayer y Antier")
)

```

```{r}
  dplyr::select(dia_siguiente, all_of(predictores_modelo)) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.))




probs_ayer_mat <- predict(modelo_1dia, newdata = df_ayer, type = "probs")
mat_h <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(df_ayer), ncol = length(niveles), dimnames = list(NULL, niveles))

if (is.matrix(probs_ayer_mat)) {
  mat_h[, colnames(probs_ayer_mat)] <- probs_ayer_mat
} else {
  mat_h[, names(probs_ayer_mat)] <- matrix(rep(probs_ayer_mat, each = nrow(df_ayer)), nrow = nrow(df_ayer))
}

df_ayer_probs <- bind_cols(
  df_ayer %>% dplyr::select(dia_siguiente, hora),
  as_tibble(mat_h * 100) %>% rename_with(~ paste0("p_", .x))
)




df_plot <- df_eval_horario %>%
  inner_join(df_ayer_probs, by = c("dia" = "dia_siguiente", "hora" = "hora")) %>%
  inner_join(predicciones, by = "dia") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    prob_h_max = max(c_across(starts_with("p_"))),
    pred_h = niveles[which.max(c_across(starts_with("p_")))],
    pred_h_final = if_else(prob_h_max > 30, pred_h, "Sin info suficiente"),
    
    es_rojo = (calidad_obj %in% c("Mala", "Muy Mala", "Extremadamente Mala") & pred_h_final %in% c("Aceptable", "Buena")) |
              (calidad_obj %in% c("Buena", "Aceptable") & pred_h_final %in% c("Mala", "Muy Mala", "Extremadamente Mala")),
    
    color_punto = if_else(es_rojo, "red", "gray"),
    
    hover_text = paste0(
      "<b>Fecha:</b> ", date, "<br>",
      "<b>O3:</b> ", round(O3_ppm, 4), " ppm<br>",
      "<b>REAL:</b> ", calidad_obj, "<br>",
      "<b>Pred:</b> ", pred_h_final, " (", round(prob_h_max, 1), "%)<br><br>",
      "<b>Probabilidades hora (modelo ayer):</b><br>",
      "Buena: ", round(p_Buena, 1), "%<br>",
      "Aceptable: ", round(p_Aceptable, 1), "%<br>",
      "Mala: ", round(p_Mala, 1), "%<br>",
      "Muy Mala: ", round(`p_Muy Mala`, 1), "%<br>",
      "Extremadamente Mala: ", round(`p_Extremadamente Mala`, 1), "%"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()




grafica_2025 <- plot_ly(data = df_plot, x = ~date) %>%
  add_lines(
    y = ~O3_ppm,
    line = list(color = "rgba(180, 180, 180, 0.6)", width = 1),
    name = "O3 (ppm)",
    hoverinfo = "none"
  ) %>%
  add_trace(
    y = ~O3_ppm,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    marker = list(
      color = ~color_punto,
      size = 5,
      opacity = 0.8
    ),
    text = ~hover_text,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    name = "Evaluación (Rojo: Error Crítico / Gris: Válido o No Relevante)"
  ) %>%
  layout(
    title = sprintf("Monitoreo Horario O3 y Detección de Errores Críticos (CE: %s a %s)", fecha_inicio, fecha_fin),
    xaxis = list(title = "Fecha y Hora"),
    yaxis = list(title = "O3 (ppm)"),
    showlegend = TRUE
  )

grafica_2025

```

```{r}
df_lineas <- df_plot %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    tipo_error = case_when(
      pred_h_final %in% c("Mala", "Muy Mala", "Extremadamente Mala") & calidad_obj %in% c("Buena", "Aceptable") ~ "Falsa Alarma (Amarillo)",
      pred_h_final %in% c("Buena", "Aceptable") & calidad_obj %in% c("Mala", "Muy Mala", "Extremadamente Mala") ~ "Peligro No Detectado (Rojo)",
      TRUE ~ "Sin Error Crítico (Gris)"
    )
  )




df_lineas <- df_lineas %>%
  mutate(
    cambio = tipo_error != lag(tipo_error, default = first(tipo_error)),
    segmento_id = cumsum(cambio)
  )

# Conectar puntos frontera entre segmentos
df_segmentos <- df_lineas %>%
  group_split(segmento_id) %>%
  map_dfr(function(seg) {
    id_seg <- seg$segmento_id[1]
    if (id_seg > 0) {
      punto_previo <- df_lineas %>% filter(segmento_id == id_seg - 1) %>% slice_tail(n = 1)
      seg <- bind_rows(punto_previo, seg)
    }
    seg
  })




grafica_lineas_error <- plot_ly()

paleta_colores <- c(
  "Sin Error Crítico (Gris)"       = "#A0A0A0",
  "Falsa Alarma (Amarillo)"        = "#E5B800",
  "Peligro No Detectado (Rojo)"    = "#D9381E"
)





for (estado in names(paleta_colores)) {
  df_sub <- df_segmentos %>% filter(tipo_error == estado | is.na(tipo_error))
  
  if (nrow(df_sub) > 0) {
    pto_dummy <- df_sub %>% filter(!is.na(O3_ppm)) %>% slice_head(n = 1)
    
    grafica_lineas_error <- grafica_lineas_error %>%
      add_trace(
        x = pto_dummy$date,
        y = pto_dummy$O3_ppm,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines",
        line = list(color = paleta_colores[estado], width = 2),
        name = estado,
        legendgroup = estado,
        showlegend = TRUE,
        hoverinfo = "none"
      ) %>%
      add_lines(
        data = df_sub,
        x = ~date,
        y = ~O3_ppm,
        split = ~segmento_id,
        line = list(color = paleta_colores[estado], width = 1.8),
        legendgroup = estado,
        showlegend = FALSE,
        hovertext = ~hover_text,
        hoverinfo = "text"
      )
  }
}



grafica_lineas_error <- grafica_lineas_error %>%
  layout(
    title = list(text = sprintf("Errores en Predicción de O3", fecha_inicio, fecha_fin), y = 0.98),
    xaxis = list(title = "Fecha y Hora"),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "O3 (ppm)",
      rangemode = "tozero"
    ),
    legend = list(
      orientation = "h",
      x = 0.5,
      xanchor = "center",
      y = 1.05
    ),
    margin = list(t = 70, b = 40)
  )

grafica_lineas_error

```

```{r}
conteo_ce_periodo <- df %>%
  filter(estacion == "CE", as.Date(date) >= fecha_inicio & as.Date(date) <= fecha_fin) %>%
  distinct(dia = as.Date(date), calidad = calidad_O3) %>%
  filter(!is.na(calidad)) %>%
  count(calidad, name = "total_dias") %>%
  mutate(
    calidad = factor(calidad, levels = niveles),
    porcentaje = round((total_dias / sum(total_dias)) * 100, 2)
  ) %>%
  complete(calidad = factor(niveles, levels = niveles), fill = list(total_dias = 0, porcentaje = 0)) %>%
  arrange(calidad)

print(as.data.frame(conteo_ce_periodo), row.names = FALSE)
```
